Live cattle futures caught some strength on Friday, with contracts up $1.10 to $1.65 at the close. December was up $1.30 on the week. Wheat Weakness Extends into the Weekend - October 16, 2026

Hog Bulls Find Footing on Friday, as Pork Sees Strength - October 16, 2026

Soybeans Slip Lower into the Weekend as Export Buying Continues - October 16, 2026
